summary.headline: Week ahead of target on both orders and revenue, and the quarter closed ahead; the year to date remains behind at 96.8% of target.

points.what: Orders came in at 1,030, 108.2% of the weekly target and up 5.1% on the prior week.
points.so_what: The week beat its volume target, and orders sat outside their 8-week range, so this is above the recent pace rather than in line with it.

points.what: Revenue was $78,682, 107.5% of the weekly target and up 124.3% on the same week last year.
points.so_what: Revenue growth is running well above the 75% growth the year's targets assume.

points.what: Q2 closed at 100.7% of the quarter-to-date revenue target, $6,522 ahead.
points.so_what: With no weeks left in the quarter, Q2 is settled ahead of target and attention shifts to the yearly gap.

points.what: Year-to-date revenue stands at 96.8% of target, a shortfall of $52,476.
points.so_what: The year is still behind despite the quarter finishing ahead, so the gap carries into the second half.

points.what: The remaining 27 weeks require $84,542 of revenue a week to reach the full-year target, against a current 8-week run-rate of $71,736.
points.so_what: At the recent pace the full-year target is out of reach.

points.what: AOV fell 5.2% week on week to $87.91, a move rated bad.
points.so_what: Revenue grew far more slowly than orders this week, so the week's gain came from order volume rather than basket size.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 08 Jun 2026 rose 0.3 pp to 9.7%, a move rated bad.
points.so_what: Returns are drifting up week on week, which is worth watching as a risk to order quality.

points.what: Both weekly targets were beaten, with orders at 108.2% and revenue at 107.5% of target.
points.so_what: The week delivered more revenue than its target required, easing rather than adding to the year-to-date shortfall.

points.what: Quarter-to-date revenue finished at $890,608 against the full-quarter target of $884,086.
points.so_what: The quarter is locked in ahead of target with no weeks left to play.

points.what: Year-to-date revenue of $1,606,165 is 96.8% of target, with $2,282,637 still to go against the full-year target.
points.so_what: The pace required over the remaining 27 weeks sits above the recent run-rate, so the year cannot be recovered at the current pace.

points.what: North America added 65 orders, 130% of the week's total order increase, with orders up 33.2%.
points.so_what: All of the week's order growth came from one region, with the others flat or lower.

points.what: Search contributed 45 orders, 90% of the week's increase, and accounts for 70.7% of orders.
points.so_what: Weekly order movement tracks Search closely, so shifts in that one source move the total.

points.what: APAC orders fell 2.0% to 446, taking 9 orders off the weekly change.
points.so_what: The largest region moved against the total, so the week's growth was not broad-based across regions.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 1.4 pp to 13.1%, a notable move rated good, with each percentage point worth $905 of revenue.
points.so_what: Fewer cancellations mean more of the week's order volume converted into revenue, supporting the revenue beat.

points.what: AOV of $87.91 is 16.5% above the same week last year.
points.so_what: Basket size remains well ahead of a year ago, so the year-on-year revenue gain is coming from both value and volume.

points.what: New customer signups were 244, up 1.2% week on week and 3.8% on last year.
points.so_what: Signup growth is running far behind order growth, so order gains are not matched on the new-account side.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 08 Jun 2026 was 9.7%, 0.6 pp below the same week last year.
points.so_what: On a yearly view returns are no worse than last year, which tempers the week-on-week rise.
